craft_notes: Sthāyin: fled-thirst (the absence-list: hunger-fear-grief-abyss-battle all GONE — the block-thesis in one colons). Sanskrit: tṛṣṇākṣayī...bhīṣaṇā...saurabhya-supti...yuddhāt patyate...jigīṣākṣayī tattvāpūrṇāvasthā → L4 keeps five-thirsts line 1, full-state line 2. Rows: row 2 (fled→full-state). Close: state (avasthā — standing: the state that REMAINS when thirsts end: subtraction-refrain with v101's remains). Rejected: 'depression' for the grief/abyss — killed: fled kept (gata — gone, not diagnosed); curiosity-thirst for jigīṣā — kept curiosity (the wish-to-kill becomes wish-to-KNOW: our gloss, curiosity kept the killing-edge soft).

lines: Hunger's end, fear, grief, abyss, battle fled:
